edges.description: Transformed HRS cells recruit and shape a supportive inflammatory niche.
Like the HRS cell, the LP cell actively manipulates and depends on its supportive lymphocyte- and histiocyte-rich microenvironment.
JAK/STAT signaling supports inflammatory niche formation.
NF-kappaB signaling sustains the inflammatory tumor niche.
Constitutive NF-kappaB signaling cooperates with checkpoint-ligand upregulation to promote immune escape.
EBV-driven NF-kappaB activation reinforces the inflammatory tumor niche.
edges.source: EBV LMP1-Mediated NF-kappaB Activation (EBV-positive Classic HL)

edges.description: The inflammatory niche is coupled to ineffective anti-tumor immunity.
The tumor-supported inflammatory niche contributes to nodal enlargement.
Cytokine-rich tumor inflammation contributes to B symptoms including fever.
Cytokine-rich tumor inflammation contributes to B symptoms including night sweats.
Cytokine-rich tumor inflammation contributes to systemic B symptoms including weight loss.

nodes.description: Neoplastic Hodgkin cells persist within a dense inflammatory infiltrate that they actively recruit and shape through cytokine and chemokine signaling, the defining tissue architecture of Hodgkin lymphoma.

evidence.reference_title: Classic Hodgkin Lymphoma - Old Disease, New Directions: An Update on Pathology, Molecular Features and Biological Prognostic Markers.
evidence.snippet: HRS cells are scattered within a dense inflammatory infiltrate, and through a network of cytokines and chemokines they shape their microenvironment, evade immune response, survive, and grow.

nodes.description: In Epstein-Barr-virus-positive classic Hodgkin lymphoma, viral latent membrane protein 1 mimics an active CD40 receptor and drives NF-kappaB activation in HRS cells.

evidence.reference_title: Analysis of the mutational landscape of classic Hodgkin lymphoma identifies disease heterogeneity and potential therapeutic targets.
evidence.snippet: However, several variants were consistently detected in genes related to relevant signaling pathways, such as GM-CSF/IL-3, CBP/EP300, JAK/STAT, NF-kappaB, and numerous variants of genes affecting the B-cell receptor (BCR) pathway, such as BTK, CARD11, BCL10, among others.

nodes.description: Destructive lesions in NF-kappaB negative regulators and gains in positive regulators drive constitutive NF-kappaB survival signaling in HRS cells.

evidence.snippet: This includes interaction with other cells in the lymphoma microenvironment through CD30, CD40, BCMA and other receptors, but also recurrent somatic genetic lesions in various factors of the NF-κB pathway, including destructive mutations in negative regulators of NF-κB signaling (e.g. TNFAIP3, NFKBIA), and copy number gains of genes encoding positive regulators (e.g. REL, MAP3K14).

nodes.description: In classic Hodgkin lymphoma the malignant Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell is derived from a germinal center B cell but loses most typical B-cell features during transformation.

evidence.reference_title: Classic Hodgkin Lymphoma - Old Disease, New Directions: An Update on Pathology, Molecular Features and Biological Prognostic Markers.
evidence.snippet: The hallmark of this disease is the neoplastic Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg (HRS) cell, which is favored to be derived from germinal center B-cells but has lost many of the B-cell markers.

nodes.description: In NLPHL the neoplastic lymphocyte-predominant (LP) cell is an infrequent large germinal-center-derived B cell that, unlike the HRS cell, retains a functional B-cell program and sits in a lymphocyte- and histiocyte-rich microenvironment.

evidence.reference_title: Hodgkin and Reed-Sternberg cells in lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin disease represent clonal populations of germinal center-derived tumor B cells.
evidence.snippet: This shows that HRS cells in LP HD are a clonal tumor population derived from germinal center B cells.

evidence.reference_title: Nodular Lymphocyte-Predominant Hodgkin Lymphoma: Update on Biology and Treatment.
evidence.snippet: In contrast to classic HL (cHL), the malignant cells in NLPB/HL lack CD30 expression but maintain a complete phenotype of mature B-cells including CD20 and IgG, but occasionally show IgD expression.

evidence.reference_title: Pitfalls in the Diagnosis of Nodular Lymphocyte Predominant Hodgkin Lymphoma: Variant Patterns, Borderlines and Mimics.
evidence.snippet: Both diagnoses are established using morphology and immunophenotype and share similarities, including the infrequent large tumor B-cells and the lymphocyte and histiocyte-rich microenvironment.
